title: Most news apps are built to keep you scrolling, not to keep you informed.
body:
We have all been there. You read a headline, scan a few paragraphs, and feel like you know the story. But five minutes later, you realize you missed the context. You know what happened, but you do not know why it matters or how we got here.

That is exactly why we built Deep Dive Mode at Headlinne. We wanted to move beyond the surface level.

Deep Dive Mode does not just summarize the news. It connects the dots. It pulls in relevant history, explains the key players, and highlights the broader implications of a single event. It turns a quick update into a complete picture.

The goal is simple. We want to help you understand the story, not just consume the words. When you have the full context, you can form your own opinions instead of just reacting to the latest alert.

I believe we need more clarity in our news feeds, not just more noise. This is our attempt to fix that.
cta: You can see how it works at HEADLINNE.com.
